_comment: Copy to data/webhooks.json (or wherever WEBHOOKS_FILE points) and delete
what you don't want. Each key becomes POST /webhook/<key>. Reload without a
preset      github | alertmanager | grafana | uptimekuma | generic
template    overrides the preset. {dotted.path} pulls from the payload;
{alerts.0.labels.instance} indexes lists. A path that isn't in
the payload renders as nothing and its leftover punctuation is
tidied away, so one template covers several event types.
match       only speak when these paths match; values compare as text, and
secret      required in ?secret= or the X-Webhook-Secret header. Most
senders can't set an Authorization header, so this stands in
for the normal token. Without it, normal auth applies.
prefix      prepended to the sentence, e.g. 'Heads up:'
max_length  truncated at a word boundary (default 300, 0 for no limit)
engine, voice, model, speed, lang, sink, volume, wait

anything._comment: No template: speaks the first of text/message/msg/body/summary/description/title/alert/content/status it finds, or the whole body if that isn't JSON.
